BibleTimes directory: Morning Star Baptist Church, Tucson AZ

notes: Historically Black Missionary Baptist congregation on the south side, self-described as 'The Love Camp of Tucson'. Address 1201 E. 26th Street, Tucson AZ 85713 re-confirmed on the church's own home page (2026-09-10); existing coordinates left as verified. Pastor Melissa R. Stanley is listed as Senior Pastor. Pastor E.A. Stanley Jr. (also written 'E. Allen Stanley, Jr.') is listed as Senior Pastor Emeritus and is NOT recorded as a preaching pastor, because nothing on the site says he still takes the pulpit regularly; both the leadership and senior-pastor pages read 'Under revision'. No denominational association (state or national Missionary Baptist convention) is stated anywhere on the site, so 'Missionary Baptist' is left as the denomination. NO SERMON ARCHIVE FOUND: the site advertises in-person worship plus a Zoom meeting ID only - no YouTube, Facebook video, podcast or sermon page. Two 'Morning Star Missionary Baptist' YouTube channels were checked and rejected as different congregations: UC6UBxNSSzDkyELyaAjrSpcA links to mymsbc.org, and @morningstarm.b.church2795 is in St. Louis, MO. A transcript-based review is likely infeasible unless recordings are obtained another way.
